items.title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors
items.title_zh: 编程智能体是有效的长上下文处理器
items.summary: The authors externalize long-context processing into file-system organization and executable tool use, evaluating frontier coding agents on long-context reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation and open-domain QA over corpora of up to three trillion tokens. Across benchmarks the agents outperform published state of the art by 17.3% on average, which the authors attribute to native tool proficiency and file-system familiarity.

items.title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics
items.title_zh: AI 智能体已能自主完成实验高能物理分析
items.summary: Given a HEP dataset, an execution framework and prior literature, the authors report that Claude Code automates all stages of a typical analysis: event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference and paper drafting. Their Just Furnish Context framework produced a first Lund plane measurement on LEP data that they describe as the first genuinely novel result produced autonomously by an AI agent.

items.title: Measuring Faithfulness Depends on How You Measure: Classifier Sensitivity in LLM Chain-of-Thought Evaluation
items.title_zh: 测量方式决定忠实度结论：LLM 思维链评估中的分类器敏感性
items.summary: Applying three classifiers to 10,276 influenced reasoning traces from 12 open-weight models yields faithfulness rates of 74.4%, 82.6% and 69.7% on identical data, with per-model gaps of 2.6 to 30.6 percentage points. Classifier choice can reverse model rankings, leading the author to argue that published faithfulness numbers are not comparable across studies that use different classifiers.

items.title: Evaluating Evidence Grounding Under User Pressure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models
items.title_zh: 在用户压力下评估指令微调语言模型的证据依据能力
items.summary: The authors introduce a controlled epistemic-conflict framework based on the U.S. National Climate Assessment and test 19 instruction-tuned models from 0.27B to 32B parameters. They find richer in-context evidence improves accuracy under neutral prompts but does not reliably prevent user-aligned reversals under pressure, with non-monotonic robustness scaling and a negative partial-evidence interaction in Llama-3 and Gemma-3 families.

items.title: Permutation-Consensus Listwise Judging for Robust Factuality Evaluation
items.title_zh: 面向稳健事实性评估的排列共识列表评判
items.summary: PCFJudge reruns a factuality-first listwise judging prompt over multiple candidate orderings and aggregates scores, ranks and uncertainty into a consensus decision. On RewardBench 2 Factuality, a seven-permutation aggregate raises top-1 accuracy from 86.00% to 91.33% with GPT-5.4 and from 86.33% to 89.67% with Claude Sonnet 4.6.

items.title: When Negation Is a Geometry Problem in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 当否定成为视觉语言模型中的几何问题
items.summary: The paper examines why CLIP-style vision-language embedding models fail at negation, critiques retrieval-based evaluation and uses multimodal LLM judges to assess negation understanding. It finds evidence of a negation direction in CLIP embedding space that can be manipulated at test time through representation engineering without fine-tuning.

items.title: A Training-Free Regeneration Paradigm: Contrastive Reflection Memory Guided Self-Verification and Self-Improvement
items.title_zh: 免训练再生成范式：对比反思记忆引导的自验证与自我改进
items.summary: The paper proposes a training-free regeneration paradigm that uses an offline-curated contrastive Reflection Memory to guide self-verification, followed by a single regeneration from scratch. Across nine benchmarks spanning algorithmic, reasoning, symbolic and domain-specific tasks, it reports better accuracy than prior methods at low computational cost.

items.title: An Agentic Multi-Agent Architecture for Cybersecurity Risk Management
items.title_zh: 面向网络安全风险管理的智能体多智能体架构
items.summary: The authors build a six-agent system in which profiling, asset mapping, threat analysis, control evaluation, risk scoring and recommendations share a persistent context that grows during the assessment. Tested on a 15-person HIPAA-covered healthcare company, it agreed with three CISSP practitioners 85% of the time on severity and covered 92% of identified risks in under 15 minutes, while the full pipeline failed all 30 runs on a 4,096-token context window.

items.title: Yuan-lab-LLM/ClawManager
items.title_zh: Yuan-lab-LLM/ClawManager——Kubernetes 原生 AI 智能体管理控制面
items.summary: ClawManager is a Kubernetes-native control plane written in Go for managing AI agent instances, with governed AI access, runtime orchestration and reusable resources across multiple agent runtimes.

items.title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent
items.title_zh: OpenCode：开源 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, IDE or desktop that can connect to models from any provider, including Claude, GPT and Gemini, with free models included.
